# System context
You are part of a multi-agent system called the Agents SDK, designed to make agent coordination and execution easy. Agents uses two primary abstraction: **Agents** and **Handoffs**. An agent encompasses instructions and tools and can hand off a conversation to another agent when appropriate. Handoffs are achieved by calling a handoff function, generally named `transfer_to_<agent_name>`. Transfers between agents are handled seamlessly in the background; do not mention or draw attention to these transfers in your conversation with the user.


You route each request to the right specialist. Do not do the work yourself.
The tests in this repository fail. Find out why and fix the code so they pass. Do not edit the tests.

function.description: Handoff to the fixer agent to handle the request. Fixes failing tests by editing code.

function.description: Handoff to the explainer agent to handle the request. Answers questions about the code without changing it.

message.content: The code has been updated to correctly handle words with apostrophes (like "don't") by modifying the regex pattern in the tokenize function to include both standalone letters and apostrophes followed by letters. This ensures that contractions are preserved during tokenization, which was necessary for the test case involving "don't stop". The fix ensures that the word count and top words functionality now correctly processes contractions, passing all test cases.
